title: U.S. House, District 23
what_it_does: Represents Florida's 23th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives; votes on federal laws and spending.
verified_ballot_note: Roster from WPTV, WLRN and Florida Politics: Lois Frankel (D) vs. Deborah Adeimy (R). The redrawn CD 23 lies entirely within Palm Beach County. No NPA candidate identified; absence unconfirmed. Sources: https://www.wptv.com/news/political/elections-local/lois-frankel-wins-democratic-nomination-for-u-s-house-in-floridas-23rd-congressional-district ; https://floridapolitics.com/archives/814105-lois-frankel-to-face-republican-challenger-deborah-adeimy-for-control-of-new-cd-23-seat/ ; https://www.wlrn.org/government-politics/2026-08-18/lois-frankel-wins-victoria-doyle-florida-23-primary Florida adopted a new congressional map (passed Apr 29, 2026, signed May 4, 2026) that reworked 21 of 28 districts; county descriptions here reflect post-redistricting reporting where found (https://www.wusf.org/politics-issues/2026-05-06/breakdown-changes-for-florida-new-congressional-map).

candidates.name: Lois Frankel
candidates.photo_source: congress.gov member portrait (bioguide ID from memory, unverified)
candidates.residence: West Palm Beach, Palm Beach County
candidates.background: Lois Frankel, a former West Palm Beach mayor and Florida House minority leader, has served in Congress since 2013 and currently represents the 22nd District; after the 2026 map she shifted her candidacy to the new 23rd. She is the ranking Democrat on the House Appropriations subcommittee on National Security, Department of State and Related Programs. She won the Aug. 18, 2026 Democratic primary with about 75%, defeating Victoria Doyle (about 23%) and Mark Piper (about 2%). Florida Politics reports she says protecting entitlements and reforming immigration are her top priorities for an eighth term.

candidates.name: Deborah Adeimy
candidates.occupation: Financial advisor / fiduciary (prior roles at Citigroup Global Markets, Merrill Lynch, Morgan Stanley, Wells Fargo Advisors and J.P. Morgan)
candidates.residence: West Palm Beach, Palm Beach County
candidates.background: Deborah Adeimy has worked in financial services as a fiduciary/financial advisor, with roles at firms including Citigroup Global Markets, Merrill Lynch, Morgan Stanley, Wells Fargo Advisors and J.P. Morgan. She ran for Congress in 2022 and 2024 (Palm Beach County's old CD 22) before this 2026 bid, and the Palm Beach Post editorial board endorsed her in a prior CD 22 Republican primary. She won the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary with about 74% of the vote over Paola Branda and faces Lois Frankel in November.
